In recent years, numerous studies have demonstrated its close association with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), and diabetic complications. Serum folate levels are decreased in patients with T2DM, which is associated with increased urinary excretion and metformin-mediated inhibition of folate absorption.
